subject: MAP draft & procurement signature deadline - alignment
messages:
From: Priya Kaur <priya.kaur@fintechco.com>

Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@fintechco.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Thanks Marissa — really helpful call today. A quick recap from our side and a couple asks so we can lock timelines: 

- Procurement needs a target contract signature date to start the budget approval flow. Our finance lead asked for a signature by 2026-11-05 to meet the Nov budget cycle.
- Security/HIPAA questions: can you send SOC 2 report and a short note on data retention?
- We'd like a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and any dependencies so we can attach it to our internal request.

Can you share a MAP draft and propose a target close date that maps to the procurement deadline?

Thanks,
Priya
Procurement Operations | FintechCo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps / MAP draft attached
Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx

Hi Priya — great talking earlier. Attaching a first-pass MAP (MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones and owners. Highlights: 

- Target commercial close: 2026-11-05 (aligns with your procurement signature request).
- Milestone: Legal review (FintechCo) — owner: Sanjay — due 2026-10-26.
- Milestone: Security review (Redwood security team) — owner: Michael Grant (cc'd) — due 2026-10-28.
- Milestone: PO issue — owner: FintechCo procurement — target 2026-10-29.
- Milestone: DocuSign send — owner: Redwood sales ops — target 2026-11-01.

Dependencies called out in the MAP: SOC 2 evidence, KMS key provisioning (if required), and negotiated SOW terms around data residency. I've also added an action item for Redwood to provide SOC 2 and a short retention note by EOD tomorrow.

Next steps: 
1) Priya/Sanjay: confirm that 2026-11-05 works as the signature date for your internal approvals.
2) Camila/Michael: I'll loop you into the security Q&A thread; Michael can assign the SOC 2 artifact.
3) I'll iterate MAP to v2 based on your feedback and upload latest to the Drive link.

Thanks — attaching MAP_draft_v1 for review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa and Camila — this looks good and the internal stakeholders prefer an earlier PO cutoff so we can route approvals. Two notes from procurement/finance: 

- We can commit to a PO by 2026-10-29 but request DocuSign sent by 2026-10-31 to allow finance to process before the Nov cycle. If possible, can you move the DocuSign send up to 10/31?
- Security: SOC 2 and retention note are required to attach to our internal request. Could Michael share those by EOD today?

If we can get SOC 2 + MAP v2 with the updated DocuSign send date, procurement will green-light the PO for 10/29 and aim to have signed contract by 2026-11-05.

Best,
Priya

- We will push the DocuSign send to 2026-10-31 (Redwood sales ops will send the envelope in the morning PT).
- FintechCo procurement commits to PO issuance by 2026-10-29.
- Target contract signature: 2026-11-05 (contract countersigned and fully executed).
- Attached: MAP_draft_v2.xlsx (I updated the DocuSign milestone to 10/31 and added Camila as onboarding owner) and Procurement_Checklist.pdf (summary of artifacts we will provide).

Michael — can you please upload the SOC 2 redacted report and a 2-line retention statement to the Drive link and reply-all so Procurement has the artifact today?

If those three items (PO by 10/29, DocuSign send 10/31, SOC2 uploaded today) are confirmed, we'll mark the MAP as "alignment confirmed" and proceed to generate the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks everyone — I'll follow up once DocuSign is sent.
